values.note: Standard site $18/night incl. 1 vehicle; $9 each additional vehicle (paid to the host on arrival). The two group tent-only sites are $36. The Forest Service page also shows an older '$17 per night' line beside '$18.00'.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/sheridan-campground ('campsites are $18.00, includes 1 vehicle $36.00 for Double Sites', '$9.00 each additional vehicle'; last updated May 5, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232775/rates (Peak Season 2025 and 2027: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $18; group tent-only $36), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/sheridan-campground ('1/2 price fees with Interagency Senior or Access Pass'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 9 sites: 7 standard back-in sites (6 reservable, site 03 first-come) for RVs and trailers, plus 2 group tent-only sites. recreation.gov: 'Sites 5 through 8 are 30 feet in length or less; the turnaround is tight for trailers and RVs.'

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/sheridan-campground ('Camp sites: 9', 'Max Trailer Length : 30ft') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232775 (Facilities text) + recreation.gov per-site catalog (sites 03-09 STANDARD NONELECTRIC, back-in, 24-33 ft; sites 01-02 GROUP TENT ONLY), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 232775 (every site typed NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Accessible vault toilets, drinking water, bear-resistant trash container; firewood $7/bundle from the host (who is based at Rattin Campground).

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/sheridan-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site.', 'Trash Pickup: Bear resistant container located on site.', 'Firewood: Yes. $7.00 / bundle', 'Host : Yes, at Rattin Campground'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: '5/26 - 9/8. Fees Charged May – September. Weather Dependent.' recreation.gov: 'Opening and closing dates are weather permitting.'

Run by concessionaire Recreation Resource Management of America (RRMA). 'FIRST COME FIRST SERVE sites must be booked in person' (site 03). Reserved sites are held 24 hours past check-in for late arrivals.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/sheridan-campground ('Camp sites: 9, a mix of reservable and first come first serve sites.', 'There is a 16-day maximum stay in all Beartooth Ranger District campgrounds.', Contact: Recreation Resource Management of America (RRMA)) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232775 (notices; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16) + per-site catalog (site 03 not reservable), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF (Beartooth RD), ~5 mi south of Red Lodge on the banks of the Main Fork of Rock Creek off East Side Road (from US 212) at ~6,300 ft. --Claude
